page.content:
Legendary founder who gave the city its name and first Senate.

How Romulus connects

  • Location: Rome — Tradition names Romulus as the founder of Rome.
  • Faction: Roman Senate — Legend has Romulus choosing the first senators.

What is Romulus?

Romulus, twin of Remus, is the foundation hero: the wall, the asylum, the rape of the Sabine women, and the first king in the tradition Livy and others retell.

Key threads lead to Rome and Roman Senate.
